lines: Drifting, drifting
Does the bird grow nostalgic for the rocks far away?
It flew high through the sky
No one knows
Looking down on streets it's never seen
What does the bird think?
Is it the same as lonely me?
Scattered, torn apart
Does the bird grow nostalgic for its flock?
It cried out in a high voice
Saying nothing
The silent city, saying nothing,
was listening to it
Is it the same as weak me?
The words of us, grown used to pain and wounds and lies,
floated on the tired river's surface and drifted away
In the town where you live
they vanished
vanished
vanished
vanished
vanished
vanished
I want to sleep with my hair still wet
The clothes I'd stripped off and dropped
were still lying there from yesterday
Saying nothing
Against the wall of the room, saying nothing,
they leaned
as if watching me, so sloppy and undone
The muttering of me, grown used to pain and wounds and lies
The wind blowing alongside the tired night
toward your cheek
it touched
it touched
it touched
it touched
it touched
You
standing in the season when you turned around
I can't remember, and it makes me sick
Even the bird that drifted and drifted
was crying out in the city, wasn't it
it was crying out, wasn't it
Waiting for the seasons gone by
I can't remember, and it makes me sick
Taking flight from being torn apart
the bird was crying out too, wasn't it
it was crying out, wasn't it
It's always waiting for us
Even the tired pain, even the wounds
Even the night that stays unchanged
I'll keep on singing
keep on singing
It's always waiting for us
Still unseen, it just keeps waiting
Even me, sloppy and weak
I'll keep on singing
keep on singing
